feature: Colorize — DDColor Tiny local inference through the production worker

artifact.provenance: Official Apache-2.0 checkpoint (piddnad/ddcolor_paper_tiny) exported with tools/ddcolor-export/export_ddcolor.py at DDColor @2adb63f2
artifact.installedAs: apps/desktop/public/models/ddcolor-tiny.onnx (local validation copy; the public path is gitignored)

environment.runtime: ONNX Runtime Web worker (WASM) inside the app

measured.note: Two passing runs; time spans model session creation, inference, and preview rendering on a concurrently loaded machine.

workflowSteps: Import a photo into the editor
Adjustments -> Colorize -> Photo Colorization (AI); loader reports a verified DDColor model
Generate preview: the ONNX Runtime worker loads the 224 MB artifact and predicts chroma
Apply: the approved chroma is rebuilt over the full-resolution source and committed as a derived layer
notCovered: The published GitHub asset was re-downloaded and hashed byte-identical, but this local run used the staged file because GitHub release assets send no CORS headers.
Native Tauri download path (implemented and unit-tested; no live Tauri E2E in this environment).
The 915 MB DDColor variant was not exercised through the browser worker.
